headline: Preparations underway to create a single electricity market in Central Asia. Details
summary: Uzbekistan, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan and Tajikistan are preparing to open a common trading platform for electricity supply to the next day. The Energiya centre has begun selecting a company to develop trading rules and run the market for its first two years.
why: A regional power market lets countries trade electricity across borders, which can improve price discovery, grid utilisation and investment in generation and transmission.
